toolsAdded.name: grep
toolsAdded.description: Search file contents for a pattern. Returns matching lines with file paths and line numbers. Respects .gitignore. Output is truncated to 100 matches or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Long lines are truncated to 500 chars.

path.description: Directory or file to search (default: current directory)

glob.description: Filter files by glob pattern, relative to path, e.g. '*.ts', 'src/**/*.ts' or '**/*.spec.ts'. A pattern without '/' matches file names at any depth

literal.description: Treat pattern as literal string instead of regex (default: false)

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (default: 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default: 100)

toolsAdded.name: find
toolsAdded.description: Search for files by glob pattern. Returns matching file paths relative to the search directory. Respects .gitignore. Output is truncated to 1000 results or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match files, e.g. '*.ts', '**/*.json', or 'src/**/*.spec.ts'

path.description: Directory to search in (default: current directory)

toolsAdded.name: ls
toolsAdded.description: List directory contents. Returns entries sorted alphabetically, with '/' suffix for directories. Includes dotfiles. Output is truncated to 500 entries or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default: 500)

-- +goose Up
-- Review rounds bind an independent Review Task to one exact Ship candidate.
CREATE TABLE review_rounds (
    ship_task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    round INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (round > 0),
    review_task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    repository TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope_kind IN ('full', 'delta', 'full_fallback')),
    scope_base_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(scope_base_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    head_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(head_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    target_commit_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(target_commit_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    baseline_tree TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(baseline_tree) IN (40, 64)),
    delta_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(delta_sha256) = 64),
    conflicted_paths_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('admitted', 'verdict', 'void')),
    verdict TEXT CHECK (verdict IN ('pass', 'changes_requested', 'inconclusive')),
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (ship_task_id, review_task_id, repository),
    CHECK ((status = 'verdict' AND verdict IS NOT NULL) OR (status IN ('admitted', 'void') AND verdict IS NULL))
);
CREATE INDEX review_rounds_ship_idx ON review_rounds(ship_task_id, round, repository);
CREATE TRIGGER review_rounds_binding_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE OF ship_task_id, round, review_task_id, repository, scope_kind,
    scope_base_sha, head_sha, target_commit_sha, baseline_tree, delta_sha256,
    conflicted_paths_json, created_at ON review_rounds
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'review round binding is immutable'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER review_rounds_terminal_status_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE OF status, verdict ON review_rounds
WHEN OLD.status <> 'admitted'
    OR NEW.status NOT IN ('verdict', 'void')
    OR (NEW.status = 'verdict' AND NEW.verdict IS NULL)
    OR (NEW.status = 'void' AND NEW.verdict IS NOT NULL)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'review round status is terminal'); END;

-- Pattern definitions are stable; merging changes only merged_into.
CREATE TABLE review_patterns (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    ship_task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (seq > 0),
    key TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    rule TEXT NOT NULL,
    root_cause TEXT NOT NULL,
    fix_guidance TEXT NOT NULL,
    merged_into INTEGER REFERENCES review_patterns(id),
    created_round INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_round > 0),
    UNIQUE (ship_task_id, seq),
    UNIQUE (ship_task_id, key),
    CHECK (merged_into IS NULL OR merged_into <> id)
);
CREATE INDEX review_patterns_ship_idx ON review_patterns(ship_task_id, seq);
CREATE TRIGGER review_patterns_definition_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE OF ship_task_id, seq, key, title, rule, root_cause, fix_guidance, created_round ON review_patterns
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'review pattern definition is immutable'); END;

-- Finding identity and evidence are immutable; its disposition state can evolve.
CREATE TABLE review_findings (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    ship_task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (seq > 0),
    pattern_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES review_patterns(id),
    fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(fingerprint) = 64),
    round INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (round > 0),
    repository TEXT NOT NULL,
    path TEXT NOT NULL,
    symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
    excerpt TEXT NOT NULL,
    line_at_report INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (line_at_report > 0),
    head_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(head_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    severity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('P0', 'P1', 'P2', 'P3', 'unclassified')),
    origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('introduced', 'pre_existing')),
    in_scope INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (in_scope IN (0, 1)),
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('open', 'fix_claimed', 'unverified', 'fixed', 'disputed', 'regressed', 'accepted', 'deferred', 'withdrawn')),
    follow_up_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    inherited_from INTEGER REFERENCES review_findings(id),
    UNIQUE (ship_task_id, seq),
    UNIQUE (ship_task_id, fingerprint)
);
CREATE INDEX review_findings_pattern_idx ON review_findings(pattern_id, seq);
CREATE INDEX review_findings_ship_idx ON review_findings(ship_task_id, state, severity);
CREATE TRIGGER review_findings_evidence_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE OF ship_task_id, seq, pattern_id, fingerprint, round, repository,
    path, symbol, excerpt, line_at_report, head_sha, inherited_from ON review_findings
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'review finding evidence is immutable'); END;

-- Event history is append-only; review_findings.state is its query-friendly projection.
CREATE TABLE review_finding_events (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    finding_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES review_findings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    round INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (round >= 0),
    event TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor TEXT NOT NULL,
    note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    user_quote TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX review_finding_events_finding_idx ON review_finding_events(finding_id, id);
CREATE TRIGGER review_finding_events_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON review_finding_events
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'review finding event is immutable'); END;

-- Carry records prove that a clean target merge preserves an exact passed tree.
CREATE TABLE review_carries (
    ship_task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    repository TEXT NOT NULL,
    from_head TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(from_head) IN (40, 64)),
    to_head TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(to_head) IN (40, 64)),
    target_commit_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(target_commit_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    tree TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(tree) IN (40, 64)),
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (ship_task_id, repository, from_head, to_head)
);
CREATE TRIGGER review_carries_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON review_carries
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'review carry is immutable'); END;

-- Dispositions retain the exact head and approval that resolved risk.
CREATE TABLE review_dispositions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    ship_task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    head_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(head_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    decision_id INTEGER REFERENCES decisions(id),

    at INTEGER NOT NULL

CREATE INDEX review_dispositions_ship_idx ON review_dispositions(ship_task_id, at, id);

BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'review disposition is immutable'); END;

-- +goose Up
-- Review rounds bind an independent Review Task to one exact Ship candidate.
CREATE TABLE review_rounds (
    ship_task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    round INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (round > 0),
    review_task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    repository TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope_kind IN ('full', 'delta', 'full_fallback')),
    scope_base_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(scope_base_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    head_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(head_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    target_commit_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(target_commit_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    baseline_tree TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(baseline_tree) IN (40, 64)),
    delta_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(delta_sha256) = 64),
    conflicted_paths_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('admitted', 'verdict', 'void')),
    verdict TEXT CHECK (verdict IN ('pass', 'changes_requested', 'inconclusive')),
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (ship_task_id, review_task_id, repository),
    CHECK ((status = 'verdict' AND verdict IS NOT NULL) OR (status IN ('admitted', 'void') AND verdict IS NULL))
);
CREATE INDEX review_rounds_ship_idx ON review_rounds(ship_task_id, round, repository);
CREATE TRIGGER review_rounds_binding_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE OF ship_task_id, round, review_task_id, repository, scope_kind,
    scope_base_sha, head_sha, target_commit_sha, baseline_tree, delta_sha256,
    conflicted_paths_json, created_at ON review_rounds
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'review round binding is immutable'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER review_rounds_terminal_status_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE OF status, verdict ON review_rounds
WHEN OLD.status <> 'admitted'
    OR NEW.status NOT IN ('verdict', 'void')
    OR (NEW.status = 'verdict' AND NEW.verdict IS NULL)
    OR (NEW.status = 'void' AND NEW.verdict IS NOT NULL)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'review round status is terminal'); END;

-- Pattern definitions are stable; merging changes only merged_into.
CREATE TABLE review_patterns (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    ship_task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (seq > 0),
    key TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    rule TEXT NOT NULL,
    root_cause TEXT NOT NULL,
    fix_guidance TEXT NOT NULL,
    merged_into INTEGER REFERENCES review_patterns(id),
    created_round INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_round > 0),
    UNIQUE (ship_task_id, seq),
    UNIQUE (ship_task_id, key),
    CHECK (merged_into IS NULL OR merged_into <> id)
);
CREATE INDEX review_patterns_ship_idx ON review_patterns(ship_task_id, seq);
CREATE TRIGGER review_patterns_definition_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE OF ship_task_id, seq, key, title, rule, root_cause, fix_guidance, created_round ON review_patterns
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'review pattern definition is immutable'); END;

-- Finding identity and evidence are immutable; its disposition state can evolve.
CREATE TABLE review_findings (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    ship_task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (seq > 0),
    pattern_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES review_patterns(id),
    fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(fingerprint) = 64),
    round INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (round > 0),
    repository TEXT NOT NULL,
    path TEXT NOT NULL,
    symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
    excerpt TEXT NOT NULL,
    line_at_report INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (line_at_report > 0),
    head_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(head_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    severity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('P0', 'P1', 'P2', 'P3', 'unclassified')),
    origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('introduced', 'pre_existing')),
    in_scope INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (in_scope IN (0, 1)),
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('open', 'fix_claimed', 'unverified', 'fixed', 'disputed', 'regressed', 'accepted', 'deferred', 'withdrawn')),
    follow_up_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    inherited_from INTEGER REFERENCES review_findings(id),
    UNIQUE (ship_task_id, seq),
    UNIQUE (ship_task_id, fingerprint)
);
CREATE INDEX review_findings_pattern_idx ON review_findings(pattern_id, seq);
CREATE INDEX review_findings_ship_idx ON review_findings(ship_task_id, state, severity);
CREATE TRIGGER review_findings_evidence_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE OF ship_task_id, seq, pattern_id, fingerprint, round, repository,
    path, symbol, excerpt, line_at_report, head_sha, inherited_from ON review_findings
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'review finding evidence is immutable'); END;

-- Event history is append-only; review_findings.state is its query-friendly projection.
CREATE TABLE review_finding_events (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    finding_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES review_findings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    round INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (round >= 0),
    event TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor TEXT NOT NULL,
    note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    user_quote TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX review_finding_events_finding_idx ON review_finding_events(finding_id, id);
CREATE TRIGGER review_finding_events_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON review_finding_events
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'review finding event is immutable'); END;

-- Carry records prove that a clean target merge preserves an exact passed tree.
CREATE TABLE review_carries (
    ship_task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    repository TEXT NOT NULL,
    from_head TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(from_head) IN (40, 64)),
    to_head TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(to_head) IN (40, 64)),
    target_commit_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(target_commit_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    tree TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(tree) IN (40, 64)),
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (ship_task_id, repository, from_head, to_head)
);
CREATE TRIGGER review_carries_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON review_carries
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'review carry is immutable'); END;

-- Dispositions retain the exact head and approval that resolved risk.
CREATE TABLE review_dispositions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    ship_task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    head_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(head_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    decision_id INTEGER REFERENCES decisions(id),
    user_quote TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX review_dispositions_ship_idx ON review_dispositions(ship_task_id, at, id);
CREATE TRIGGER review_dispositions_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON review_dispositions
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'review disposition is immutable'); END;

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:103: ### 2.3 The Verdict record and the gate
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-104- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-105- One insert-only table, in the shape ADR 0020 gave review targets:
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-106- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-107- | Column | From |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-108- |---|---|
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-109- | `task_id`, `repo` (the Change Task and, in a Workspace, the Member) | Posse |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-110- | `provider` (`greenhouse` or `builtin`), `protocol` | Posse |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-111- | `grant` (unique) | Posse issues it; Greenhouse refuses a reused grant |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-112- | `head`, `target`, `review_base` | `host_result` |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-113- | `verdict` (`clean`, `findings`, `inconclusive`) | `host_result` |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-114- | `blocking` (count of findings at or above the frozen `block_at`; meaningful only when `verdict = findings`) | Posse computes |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-115- | `rules_digest`, `config_digest`, `input_digest`, `backend`, `model` | `host_result` |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-116- | `findings_digest`, findings file path | Posse |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-117- | `mode` (`parallel` or `gate`), `recorded_at` | Posse |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-118- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:119: Qualification is computed when read, as today: a Verdict passes only if all three hold: `mode = gate`; `verdict` is `clean`, or `verdict` is `findings` and `blocking = 0`; and `head` equals the head being published or merged now. An `inconclusive` Verdict never passes, whatever its `blocking` count, and neither does a missing one. No operation rebinds a Verdict to another head. A moved head has no passing Verdict.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-120- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-121- Exact-head safety therefore has two independent checks: Greenhouse sets `current: false` "once the worktree branch or head moved" (`GH:docs/embedding.md`), and Posse compares the recorded `head` with the head being merged inside the merge transaction. Posse's check does not trust Greenhouse's.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-122- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-123- ### 2.4 Process placement (from an experiment)
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-124- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-125- [O] In an isolated run (appendix N1), `greenhouse axi attach` from a shell inside a Posse Task started the Greenhouse daemon with `setsid`, and the daemon stayed in the caller's Task cgroup and inherited its `POSSE_TASK_ID`. [O] Teardown stops cgroup members and processes that carry the Task marker (`docs/spec.md:634`).
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-126-

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-206- Consequences:
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-207- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-208- - **`posse validate test|docs|lint` leaves with built-in review.** Nothing replaces it inside Posse or Greenhouse. A Project that wants tests, docs checks and lint to gate a merge puts them in its forge workflows, where they run at the exact head and cannot be self-reported. No Greenhouse host-mode pipeline stage is added.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:209: - **The Private Candidate leaves.** [O] Host mode reviews a local commit in the worktree and "Creates no private worktree, candidate ref or lease" (`GH:docs/embedding.md`). Posse refuses to push a head without a passing Verdict. "Nothing reaches the target before validation" becomes one comparison of two commit ids. The order under `full-pipeline` is review, publish, CI, Merge: review is the only evidence available before a push, and CI is the only evidence about tests, docs and lint.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:210: - **The merge gate is one conjunction** for a Task that requires review: the PR head equals `gated_sha`, a passing Verdict exists for that head, forge CI is green at that head, and Merge is authorized by `autonomy.merge` or the User. The first, third and fourth conditions exist today. Only the source of the second changes.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:211: - **`local` merge mode** has the Verdict and no CI. That is today's guarantee for `local` and is stated to the User at admission, not hidden.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-212- - **Documentation review** that `full-pipeline` did through `posse validate docs` is covered by Greenhouse rules ([O] the embedding example selects the rules `unslop` and `no-comments`) and by any docs job in CI.

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-118- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:119: Qualification is computed when read, as today: a Verdict passes only if all three hold: `mode = gate`; `verdict` is `clean`, or `verdict` is `findings` and `blocking = 0`; and `head` equals the head being published or merged now. An `inconclusive` Verdict never passes, whatever its `blocking` count, and neither does a missing one. No operation rebinds a Verdict to another head. A moved head has no passing Verdict.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-120- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-121- Exact-head safety therefore has two independent checks: Greenhouse sets `current: false` "once the worktree branch or head moved" (`GH:docs/embedding.md`), and Posse compares the recorded `head` with the head being merged inside the merge transaction. Posse's check does not trust Greenhouse's.

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-195- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-196- [O] Today `full-pipeline` means a Private Candidate passes review, then `posse validate test`, `docs` and `lint`, before every publication (`CONTEXT.md`, Review Mode). [O] Those three stages record what the Worker claims it ran (report section G). [O] ADR 0028 already makes forge CI at the recorded head the verification for PR delivery and states that local delivery has no automated verification.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-197- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-198- With Greenhouse as the reviewer the three modes mean:
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-199- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-200- | `defaults.review` | Evidence required | Checked |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-201- |---|---|---|
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-202- | `none` | forge CI at the gated head, for `pr` mode | before Merge, as today |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:203: | `quick` | a current passing Verdict for the head being merged, plus forge CI at that head for `pr` mode | before Merge, where `requireSelectedReviewForMerge` checks today (`internal/app/review_verdict.go:239`) |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:204: | `full-pipeline` | a current passing Verdict for the head being published, then forge CI at that same head | before `posse publish` pushes, and again before Merge |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-205- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-206- Consequences:
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-207- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-208- - **`posse validate test|docs|lint` leaves with built-in review.** Nothing replaces it inside Posse or Greenhouse. A Project that wants tests, docs checks and lint to gate a merge puts them in its forge workflows, where they run at the exact head and cannot be self-reported. No Greenhouse host-mode pipeline stage is added.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:209: - **The Private Candidate leaves.** [O] Host mode reviews a local commit in the worktree and "Creates no private worktree, candidate ref or lease" (`GH:docs/embedding.md`). Posse refuses to push a head without a passing Verdict. "Nothing reaches the target before validation" becomes one comparison of two commit ids. The order under `full-pipeline` is review, publish, CI, Merge: review is the only evidence available before a push, and CI is the only evidence about tests, docs and lint.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:210: - **The merge gate is one conjunction** for a Task that requires review: the PR head equals `gated_sha`, a passing Verdict exists for that head, forge CI is green at that head, and Merge is authorized by `autonomy.merge` or the User. The first, third and fourth conditions exist today. Only the source of the second changes.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:211: - **`local` merge mode** has the Verdict and no CI. That is today's guarantee for `local` and is stated to the User at admission, not hidden.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-212- - **Documentation review** that `full-pipeline` did through `posse validate docs` is covered by Greenhouse rules ([O] the embedding example selects the rules `unslop` and `no-comments`) and by any docs job in CI.

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:119: Qualification is computed when read, as today: a Verdict passes only if all three hold: `mode = gate`; `verdict` is `clean`, or `verdict` is `findings` and `blocking = 0`; and `head` equals the head being published or merged now. Posse's check does not trust Greenhouse's.

[O] Those three stages record what the Worker claims it ran (report section G). [O] ADR 0028 already makes forge CI at the recorded head the verification for PR delivery and states that local delivery has no automated verification.

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-199- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-200- | `defaults.review` | Evidence required | Checked |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-201- |---|---|---|
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-202- | `none` | forge CI at the gated head, for `pr` mode | before Merge, as today |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:203: | `quick` | a current passing Verdict for the head being merged, plus forge CI at that head for `pr` mode | before Merge, where `requireSelectedReviewForMerge` checks today (`internal/app/review_verdict.go:239`) |

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-205- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-206- Consequences:
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-207- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-208- - **`posse validate test|docs|lint` leaves with built-in review.** Nothing replaces it inside Posse or Greenhouse. A Project that wants tests, docs checks and lint to gate a merge puts them in its forge workflows, where they run at the exact head and cannot be self-reported. No Greenhouse host-mode pipeline stage is added.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:209: - **The Private Candidate leaves.** [O] Host mode reviews a local commit in the worktree and "Creates no private worktree, candidate ref or lease" (`GH:docs/embedding.md`). Posse refuses to push a head without a passing Verdict. "Nothing reaches the target before validation" becomes one comparison of two commit ids. The order under `full-pipeline` is review, publish, CI, Merge: review is the only evidence available before a push, and CI is the only evidence about tests, docs and lint.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:210: - **The merge gate is one conjunction** for a Task that requires review: the PR head equals `gated_sha`, a passing Verdict exists for that head, forge CI is green at that head, and Merge is authorized by `autonomy.merge` or the User. The first, third and fourth conditions exist today. Only the source of the second changes.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:211: - **`local` merge mode** has the Verdict and no CI. That is today's guarantee for `local` and is stated to the User at admission, not hidden.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-212- - **Documentation review** that `full-pipeline` did through `posse validate docs` is covered by Greenhouse rules ([O] the embedding example selects the rules `unslop` and `no-comments`) and by any docs job in CI.

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:119: Qualification is computed when read, as today: a Verdict passes only if all three hold: `mode = gate`; `verdict` is `clean`, or `verdict` is `findings` and `blocking = 0`; and `head` equals the head being published or merged now. An `inconclusive` Verdict never passes, whatever its `blocking` count, and neither does a missing one. No operation rebinds a Verdict to another head. A moved head has no passing Verdict.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-120- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-121- Exact-head safety therefore has two independent checks: Greenhouse sets `current: false` "once the worktree branch or head moved" (`GH:docs/embedding.md`), and Posse compares the recorded `head` with the head being merged inside the merge transaction. Posse's check does not trust Greenhouse's.

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-206- Consequences:
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-207- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-208- - **`posse validate test|docs|lint` leaves with built-in review.** Nothing replaces it inside Posse or Greenhouse. A Project that wants tests, docs checks and lint to gate a merge puts them in its forge workflows, where they run at the exact head and cannot be self-reported. No Greenhouse host-mode pipeline stage is added.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:209: - **The Private Candidate leaves.** [O] Host mode reviews a local commit in the worktree and "Creates no private worktree, candidate ref or lease" (`GH:docs/embedding.md`). Posse refuses to push a head without a passing Verdict. "Nothing reaches the target before validation" becomes one comparison of two commit ids. The order under `full-pipeline` is review, publish, CI, Merge: review is the only evidence available before a push, and CI is the only evidence about tests, docs and lint.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:210: - **The merge gate is one conjunction** for a Task that requires review: the PR head equals `gated_sha`, a passing Verdict exists for that head, forge CI is green at that head, and Merge is authorized by `autonomy.merge` or the User. The first, third and fourth conditions exist today. Only the source of the second changes.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:211: - **`local` merge mode** has the Verdict and no CI. That is today's guarantee for `local` and is stated to the User at admission, not hidden.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-212- - **Documentation review** that `full-pipeline` did through `posse validate docs` is covered by Greenhouse rules ([O] the embedding example selects the rules `unslop` and `no-comments`) and by any docs job in CI.

00045_review_verdicts.sql-1- -- +goose Up
00045_review_verdicts.sql-2- -- A Review Task is bound at admission to the exact commit of each repository
00045_review_verdicts.sql-3- -- in the completed Ship candidate. Targets can be inserted but never changed.
00045_review_verdicts.sql:4: CREATE TABLE review_targets (
00045_review_verdicts.sql-5-     task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
00045_review_verdicts.sql-6-     repository TEXT NOT NULL,
00045_review_verdicts.sql-7-     commit_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(commit_sha) = 40 OR length(commit_sha) = 64),
00045_review_verdicts.sql-12- 
00045_review_verdicts.sql-13- -- One verdict per Review Task, written in the same transaction as its done
00045_review_verdicts.sql-14- -- Signal. signal_id is informational: rebuilds restore verdicts without Signals.
00045_review_verdicts.sql:15: CREATE TABLE review_verdicts (
00045_review_verdicts.sql-16-     task_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
00045_review_verdicts.sql-17-     signal_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
00045_review_verdicts.sql-18-     verdict TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (verdict IN ('pass', 'changes_requested', 'inconclusive')),
00045_review_verdicts.sql-24-     model_known INTEGER NOT NULL,
00045_review_verdicts.sql-25-     created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
00045_review_verdicts.sql-26- );
00045_review_verdicts.sql:27: CREATE TRIGGER review_verdicts_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON review_verdicts
00045_review_verdicts.sql-28- BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'review verdict is immutable'); END;
